collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager wants to propose with a carved ring hidden in a fruit: try the fruit plan, or simply ask.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has carved a ring from a shell and wants to hide it inside a ripe fruit, so (friend) finds it when (friend.he/she) bites in. (subject)'s friends have pointed out several ways this could go wrong, most of them involving teeth. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) hands (friend) the fruit. (friend) bites, stops, and slowly pulls the ring out. "Is this...?" (friend.he/she) asks. (subject) nods. (friend) says yes with (friend.his/her) mouth full of fruit. Nobody's teeth are harmed.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) gives up on the fruit, holds out the ring and asks. (friend) says yes. Later, (friend) finds out about the fruit plan and is very sorry to have missed it, and asks (subject) to put the ring in a fruit anyway, just so (friend.he/she) can find it.
